bugs.summary: www.gsmarena.com -  The embedded videos fail to load due to "No video with supported format and MIME type found" error

comments.author: bfarkas@mozilla.com
comments.creator: bfarkas@mozilla.com
comments.raw_text:
**Environment:**
Operating system: Windows
Firefox version: Firefox 151.0 (release) /  Firefox Nightly 153.0a1 (2026-05-26)

**Preconditions:**
- Clean profile

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Navigate to: https://www.gsmarena.com/google_android_17_continue_on-news-72910.php
2. Scroll down the page until the embedded videos
3. Observe the page

**Expected Behavior:**
The embedded videos can be played accordingly

**Actual Behavior:**
 "No video with supported format and MIME type found" error is displayed and the embedded videos cannot be played

**Notes:**
- Reproducible on the latest Firefox Release and Nightly
- Reproducible regardless of the ETP setting
- Works as expected using Chrome

---
